items.title: Reject false chess claims on actual development positions
items.instructions: Read the exact retained experiment, strict acceptance receipt, supervision record, and no-forward capability gate before proposing work. The separately versioned evaluator-only experiment already exists: scripts/chess_extended_claim_factuality_experiment.py (frozen source SHA-256 b0e2cc3415c07a54afd8cc0e921f77538f59cfcb60413dc2e0598d86c6f4baed), its tests, and artifacts/chess-extended-claim-factuality-v1/dev8-20260923/{manifest,report}.json. The frozen result replayed 191 development claims: 64/64 valid claims accepted and 127/127 false controls abstained, with no model, engine, or heldout calls. A separate strict acceptance layer and create-only receipt now bind the frozen inputs and reject a faithfully replayed legacy-complete result with incomplete valid coverage or false acceptance. Do not recreate, rerun, overwrite, or modify any v1 source, manifest, report, receipt, historical adapter, task identity, or retained evidence; unchanged tests and source reads are not progress. The remaining blocker is independent source acceptance: two local callbacks received bounded source/test/result material yet omitted their mandatory structured verdict fields. Do not repeat a generic planner, generic research refresh, or third prompt-only reviewer. The only in-scope next step for this item is one bounded project-owned repair that machine-validates the required callback fields (VERDICT, FUNCTIONS, INTEGRATION, HASHES, LIMITATION) before a source-review task can settle, followed by a retained review of the existing frozen source/test/result bundle. If that protocol repair is not reachable through the project workflow, return the exact ownership boundary and no speculative implementation. Deterministic evaluator acceptance is not independent acceptance and does not unlock the commentary gate. This remains evaluator-only: a full typed packet, post-move FEN, PV, solution/theme, annotation, future-derived feature, or evaluator material must never enter a commentary generator. No model/engine calls, heldout scoring, commentary-quality claim, professional-commentator claim, or board-game expansion is authorized.

items.title: Build and test a no-forward Stockfish chess-commentary candidate
items.instructions: Read research/chess-commentary-capability-gate-v1.md first. The current chess_concept_model prompt exposes retained engine PVs, so it cannot meet the requested commentator constraint. Implement a separately versioned no-forward commentator packet and evaluator without changing historic receipt formats or sibling-owned legacy model files unless ownership is coordinated. The generator may see only the pre-move FEN, selected move, deterministic transition facts, typed engine observation and declared concept vocabulary; it must never receive pv_uci, a post-move FEN, solution/theme, reply sequence, human annotation or continuation-derived feature. Add fail-first tests for every forbidden field, provenance/hash binding, legal board claims, engine-reference attribution, strategic-claim uncertainty and abstention. Freeze a new game-disjoint heldout protocol before any quality result; do not use the historical eight test items as blind evidence. Run local implementation/tests through the native executor, retain raw packets and complete failures, and send the exact result to independent acceptance. Do not call the result professional-level or expand to other board games unless every condition in the gate document, including independent qualified review, is actually satisfied. A passing structural test is only a candidate capability, not a commentary-quality result.
